## Summary

Saroj Prasad Mainali is a full-stack engineer who has shipped 100+ products for 19+ companies across Nepal and internationally. He works across the entire stack — from React/Next.js frontends to FastAPI/Django backends, Flutter mobile apps, TensorFlow/PyTorch models, Docker/Kubernetes infrastructure, and climate modeling with WEAP/SWAT.

He co-founded Elytra Solutions (CTO) and is Lead Developer at Neuron Nest, an EdTech company building LMS platforms for schools in Nepal. He is also Technical Head at KS Photography Station, where he built an AI photo-culling pipeline.

## Professional Experience

1. Lead Developer @ Neuron Nest (2023 – Present)
   - Building a multi-tenant LMS platform for schools
   - LLM-powered assessment tools and analytics dashboards
   - Tech: Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker

2. CTO & Co-founder @ Elytra Solutions (2022 – Present)
   - Technical leadership across 15+ client projects
   - Multi-tenant SaaS architecture, DevOps pipelines
   - Tech: Next.js, NestJS, Python, Flutter, Kubernetes

3. Technical Head @ KS Photography Station (2022 – Present)
   - AI photo-culling pipeline for wedding photography workflows
   - NAS infrastructure setup and maintenance
   - Tech: Python, TensorFlow, OpenCV

4. Freelance Full-Stack Developer (2020 – Present)
   - 19+ client companies across EdTech, HealthTech, AgriTech, government, finance
   - Projects include civic data platforms, donor management systems, CRMs
   - Tech: Next.js, FastAPI, Flutter, PostgreSQL

## Notable Projects

- **Devanagari OCR**: CNN achieving 99.98% accuracy on handwritten Nepali character recognition. Android draw-and-predict app. Published research. (TensorFlow, Python, Android)
- **Perceparator**: Transformer-based real-time dual-speaker audio separation trained on LibriMix dataset. (PyTorch, Python)
- **Amarnepal**: Civic data platform analyzing Nepal federal budgets with animated trend charts and editorial analysis. (Next.js, TypeScript)
- **Void Social**: Multi-tenant social media management platform with AES-256-GCM encryption and full RBAC. (Next.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL)
- **Project Lakhey**: NGO and donor management system with public donor wall, event calendar, and impact tracking. (Next.js, Prisma, Cloudinary)
